provenance.note: julia-mono was swept on its own; the other three rows are the earlier run. This machine no longer reproduces that run: a re-sweep of the pristine tree measures the same limits as the julia-mono sweep, 1px more permissive on 160 of 414 rows, with no change to any 16px row. The earlier, stricter numbers are kept because they are the ones tokens.css locks, and nothing measured here contradicts them.
